title: Neutrino Observation Binding
description: The BINDING-side contract (M5 oracle S5, ) that maps a portable oracle attestation policy (neutrino.capability-spec `attestations[]`, ) to CONCRETE observers: the observer-set membership, each observer's identity + public key, and a mocked external source descriptor. Deployment-specific, so it lives OUTSIDE the portable spec — the spec declares WHICH observer-set REFERENCE gates an evidence input and the M threshold; this binding supplies the concrete observers, keys, N, and source. The oracle-observer backend () and the on-chain acceptance guard () render FROM this. Fail-closed (additionalProperties:false everywhere). Validated by scripts/validators/validate_observation_binding.py, which mirrors this schema AND enforces the cross-references JSON Schema cannot express: observer-identity uniqueness within a set, and — given the capability-spec — that every attestation observer-set reference is bound and its M is achievable by the bound N (M <= N). See docs/binding/ORACLE_OBSERVATION_BINDING.md.

member.description: One concrete observer: a binding-local identity and its public key. Members are binding-level (never portable spec).

id.description: Observer identity, unique within its set. Restricted to a safe identifier charset (it reaches generated filenames + code, so no path traversal / control chars / injection).

publicKey.description: The observer's public key (secp256k1). Non-empty: the aggregator authorizes the quorum by public key, so a missing key would let an unauthenticated attestation count.

source.description: The mocked external source descriptor the observers read. Deployment-specific and NEVER moved into the portable spec. Only `mock` is supported today (deterministic, injectable); real source kinds are a declared extension point.

type.description: Supported source descriptor kind. `mock` is the only kind today; an unsupported type is rejected fail-closed.

id.description: Source identity (safe identifier charset — it reaches generated code).

claimField.description: The observation field the observers canonicalize into the signed claim.

observerSet.description: The concrete binding of one observer-set REFERENCE (matching a capability-spec attestation's observerSet.ref).

ref.description: The observer-set reference this entry binds — matches attestations[].observerSet.ref in the capability-spec.

assurance.description: Declared deployment-side assurance tier for this observer set. When the portable capability-spec declares observerSet.assurance, this binding value must match it exactly.

independence.description: Declared deployment-side independence posture for this observer set. When the portable capability-spec declares observerSet.independence, this binding value must match it exactly.

members.description: The concrete observers (N). N is binding-level; the validator checks M <= N against the spec's threshold. Identities MUST be unique within the set (schema uniqueItems is insufficient — the validator enforces id-uniqueness precisely).

domain.description: OPTIONAL EIP-712 acceptance-guard domain (oracle S7, ): the deployment-side facts that domain-separate the signed digest so the rendered observers sign EXACTLY the preimage the on-chain guard (ThresholdQuorumAcceptance.sol, /) verifies — the observer↔guard parity point. Absent = the observer signs the naked canonical-claim digest (S4 default, no bound guard). Present = the observer co-signs the EIP-712 digest over (chainId, verifyingContract, capabilityHash-from-spec, claimId, canonicalClaimHash, executionClaim) — the evidence claim AND the  execution claim, binding the attested evidence to the exact execution it authorizes. The third domain field, capabilityHash, is NOT here — it is the spec's identity, bound at render.

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain id of the deployed acceptance guard.

verifyingContract.description: The deployed guard contract address (EIP-712 verifyingContract).

observerSets.description: One entry per bound observer-set reference.
